title: Close the Window
setup: The bishop on **b7** checks your king along the longest diagonal on the board.
hint: Your king has no safe square — g1 and h2 are both covered. Can your rook step into the diagonal?
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop on b7 checks along the whole long diagonal into your king on h1. The exits are sealed: the bishop on c5 covers g1, and the pawn on g3 covers h2.

A diagonal check is still a line check, and lines can be blocked. {{Rg2}} slides along the second rank into the bishop's path. If {{Bxg2+}} follows, {{Kxg2}} takes back.

A rook cannot move diagonally, but it can stand on a diagonal.
